test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.

The development of the region also depended on the ________ (rapaciousness) of the corporate contribution via a social responsibility scheme.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Generosity)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"rapaciousness"** means aggressively greedy or grasping. (लालचपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **The rapaciousness of the invaders led to the plundering of the city's treasures.
 
 
 
• **"Generosity" **refers to the quality of being kind and generous; willingness to give more of something, such as money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदारता)

 
 
• **Example: **Her generosity in donating to the charity was deeply appreciated by all.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'rapaciousness'** is **'generosity'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Generosity)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Voracity **(भूख): The quality or state of being voracious; having a huge appetite.

 
 
• **Example:** The voracity of the young boy was evident as he devoured his meal.
 
 
 
• **Greed **(लालच): Intense and selfish desire for something, especially wealth, power, or food.

 
 
• **Example: **His greed for money led him down a dark path.
 
 
 
• **Violence** (हिंसा): Behavior involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** The outbreak of violence in the city was a cause for concern among residents.
